label: Some actual root is fixed toward a being its end does not require, and two-way toward another
paraphrase: OPEN standing rival to WN (0266eac2), analyst formulation, unattributed: some actual root n of the selected grounding relation G at w exercises a rational power toward a being x other than itself, is fixed toward x (NECESSITATE_5: gives x being at w and at every accessible world where n exists), x is not required by n's own end (EndRequires, the means-to-end relation), and n is two-way toward some being. Combines the necessary-diffusion thesis (Plotinus; Avicenna's First as standardly reported; Kretzmann; cited for the diffusion component only, navigation) with free giving of the contingents. No source is recorded as holding the combination; it is #1947 section 9's selective version. The Lean fixes n toward x; with a necessary root and factive giving, x then exists wherever n does. Neither necessity nor intermediacy of x is stated. #1947's MixedModeRoot (b8ee1a50) has FixedTowardAt g d, TwoWayTowardAt g c and the failure of WN with EndRequires empty, and keeps N3's other premises: it witnesses the shape, and does not register this statement. Stated only: no argument here supports or refutes it.
